field_of_view_deg: 91.3 to 44.2 horizontal, 49.3 to 24.8 vertical, 108.6 to 50.9 diagonal

power.method: PoE (802.3at, Type 2, Class 4) max. 23.1W, 12 VDC max. 21.6W, or 24 VAC max. 20.8W

features: DeepinView deep-learning analytics: face capture, multi-target-type detection (human body, face, vehicle), license plate recognition (ANPR on /P variant)
regional people counting, multi-dimension people counting, queue management, on/off duty detection, heat map
perimeter protection: line crossing, intrusion, region entrance, region exiting (human/vehicle target filtering)
PPE detection (hard hat and reflective clothing), activity analysis (smoking / phone call)
AI Open Platform (HEOP 2.0, up to 3 loadable models, 2.5 TOPS), AcuSeek search (with AcuSeek NVR/servers)
DarkFighter 2.0 low-light, ShotN technology for clear capture of fast-moving vehicles and humans
150 dB AWDR, motorized varifocal (P-iris), high frame rate up to 2MP@120fps / 4MP@60fps
hybrid supplement light — IR + white light, monitoring up to 100 m; Smart Supplement Light
built-in heater, demist, G-sensor vibration detection, built-in power meter, EIS

home_assistant.notes: Use ONVIF integration. Default ONVIF port 80.

release_notes: 4MP DarkFighter DeepinView motorized-varifocal (10-50mm, P-iris) bullet on a 1/1.2" sensor with DeepinView deep-learning analytics: face capture, multi-target-type detection, people counting/queue management, perimeter protection and PPE detection; /P variant adds ANPR. DarkFighter 2.0, 150 dB WDR, hybrid IR+white supplement light to 100m, built-in heater and G-sensor. Specs verified against the official Hikvision datasheet iDS-2CD7A47G2H-XZHSY_Datasheet_20260820.
